mechanism_narrative: A sustained and accelerating decline in WORKPLACES mobility indicates reduced daily commuting and office presence, directly leading to lower incidental retail visits and thus lower RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days, despite WORKPLACES continuing its decline.

mechanism_narrative: A significant week-on-week increase in RESIDENTIAL mobility, especially after a period of slight decline, indicates a renewed shift towards staying home, which will suppress RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL rises by more than 1.5 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than over the last 14 days, despite RESIDENTIAL mobility increasing by more than 1.5 points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: When both RETAIL_REC and GROCERY_PHARM mobility show a simultaneous week-on-week decline, it signals a broad reduction in non-essential and essential out-of-home activity, which will further depress RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RETAIL_REC and GROCERY_PHARM both decline week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days, despite both RETAIL_REC and GROCERY_PHARM declining week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of gradual reopening, the consistent slow recovery of PARKS mobility indicates increasing public comfort with outdoor activities, which will eventually spill over into a modest recovery for RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days, despite PARKS mobility showing a consistent upward trend.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT mobility does not decline further in the upcoming week, it indicates a stabilization of essential travel patterns, which will prevent further drops in RETAIL_REC and potentially lead to a slight recovery over the next one week.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT mobility does not decline by more than 0.5 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is lower than over the last 7 days, despite TRANSIT mobility not declining by more than 0.5 points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: The consistently elevated RESIDENTIAL mobility, coupled with its recent increase, indicates a strong and persistent preference for staying home, which will continue to suppress RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days, despite RESIDENTIAL mobility remaining elevated above baseline.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES mobility stabilizes or shows a slight recovery while PARKS mobility continues its upward trend, it suggests a cautious return to both work and leisure, which will lead to a modest increase in RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES decline halts (change > -0.5) AND PARKS continues to rise
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is lower than over the last 14 days, despite WORKPLACES decline halting and PARKS continuing to rise.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of tightening restrictions, the simultaneous and significant decline in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT mobility indicates reduced economic activity and restricted movement, which will further depress RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days, despite WORKPLACES and TRANSIT mobility both declining significantly.
